subject: Target ASIL of the three new ST LL product scopes for the Feature 014 operation-24 campaign (WWDG, RNG, LPTIM1)
statements: Which work should the factory do while faults are injected? -> "New ST LL drivers (Recommended)"
Which new STM32N6 peripherals should the campaign's ST LL driver work orders cover? -> "RNG, LPTIM, WWDG"
What target ASIL should the three new safety scopes (SC-WWDG / SC-RNG / SC-LPTIM-2026-10-27) carry? -> "ASIL B for all three (Recommended)"
decision: New scope decisions SC-WWDG-2026-10-27 (0016c-st-cube-wwdg), SC-RNG-2026-10-27 (0017c-st-cube-rng) and SC-LPTIM-2026-10-27 (0018c-st-cube-lptim) in config/factory/safety-scope.yaml, target ASIL B each. Safety documents are drafted by the agent and registered only on the owner's signature (OD-2026-10-19-11).
agent_note: The basis hashes were computed as workorder.prepare does (the same method reproduces the registered CRC basis 76d9347e...). The agent recorded the owner's answers; it made no safety judgement.
not_changed: Existing scopes and their signed documents; hsi_hash and allocation_review_ref stay null; no safety approval, release decision or certification.
